raw_sections.skills:
SKILLS
❖ Financial Crime Compliance: AML Risk Assessment, KYC/CDD/EDD, Transaction Monitoring ❖ Regulatory Compliance (FATF,FCA,EU AML directives,FIU India, RBI,SEBI,OFAC,MAS,VARA,
CBUAE,SAMA,QCB,CBB,CBK), Crypto Compliance/VASP/Travel Rule ❖ Risk and Control:Control Testing, Audit readiness, MAP remediation ❖ Transformation:TOM design,Change Management, UAT, Process Re-engineering ❖ LeaderCross-functional leadership with Program Mgmt, WFM, Vendor Mgmt,Workforce Planning
TOOLS & PLATFORMS
❖ TM Systems: OFSAA(MANTAS), Actimize SAM, TRACER, SAS ❖ Screening Systems: World Check, RDC, Lexisnexis, DDIQ ❖ Analytics: Power BI, Advanced Excel, Google Sheets, SQL ❖ Network Analytics: Quantexa, Behavox ❖ Blockchain Analytics: Chainalysis, TRM Labs, KYT ❖ Automation: API integrations, no-code AI tools, Power Apps and Microsoft Azure ❖ Project Management: JIRA, Confluence
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
❖ Improved Transaction Monitoring detection accuracy by 35% through scenario tuning and threshold
optimization.
❖ Delivered 8000+ KYC remediations under regulatory timelines ❖ Built and scaled AML operations supporting 120+ FTE across QA and delivery ❖ Improved productivity by ~70% through AI-enabled workflow automation ❖ Delivered 24 FTE equivalent capacity savings through process optimization
raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
PWC AC | Manager - Anti Financial Crimes Unit , Hyderabad | January 2021 to April 2026
Leadership & Delivery
❖ Strategic people leader with a proven track record of managing large-scale operations and
performance for up to 120 full-time professionals. Expert in driving career progression, designing targeted training programs, and managing diverse teams ranging from consultants and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to team leads.
❖ Designed and implemented governance frameworks (WBR/MBR/QBR) with KPI dashboards
(productivity, quality, aging) improving decision making and reducing rework across onboarding and periodic review process
❖ Provided senior leadership and Board-level reporting on KYC risk exposure, operational gaps, and process standardization initiatives, strengthening First Line of Defense(1LOD) effectiveness ❖ Built cross-functional operating models in collaboration with Compliance Program Management,
Analytics, QA and Workforce/Vendor Management teams to optimize staffing,productivity and quality benchmarks
Transformation & Advisory
❖ Led Policy & Procedure enhancements and Periodic Review transformation initiatives,including
data/document refresh and design of a global periodic review operating model aligned with updated KYC regulatory requirements
❖ Delivered regulatory driven remediation by implementing bearer share policy changes, successfully
completing 3000+ client file reviews with sustainable control enhancements
❖ Spearheaded AI enabled screening transformation initiatives, including automation strategy, API
integration resolution, and transition to enhanced screening frameworks
Optimization & Innovation
❖ Identified process inefficiencies across AML/TM workflows and introduced target improvements ❖ Built a no-code AI enabled workflow integrating third-party screening data, reducing adverse media
review effort by 40% and improving investigator productivity by ~70%
❖ Introduced continuous improvement practices across QA/QC, training, and operations to improve
quality,reduce rework, and improve SLA adherence
PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE
HSBC PLC | Control Manager - Risk and Compliance, Bangalore| May 2017 - January 2021
As a Risk Control Manager
❖ Managed global AML control environment(KYC, TM, Screening) across 3 GCCs for UK and MENA
regions
❖ Ran control evidence lifecycle; centralized artifacts in SharePoint by site/function for audit-readiness and efficient retrieval; partnered with Internal Control Testing and External Audit on observations and Management Action Plans
❖ Built tiered training plans to strengthen control awareness and reduce breach risk; improved
consistency of control execution across sites
As an Assistant Manager
❖ Led a team of 15 senior analysts delivering L2 TM investigation/SAR recommendation for APAC,UK and
MENA region for correspondent banking; owned SLAs/KPIs, scheduling, capacity planning, and performance management
❖ Managed Trade and communication surveillance team of 18 analysts monitoring trade at L1 and L2 for
APAC and MENA regions
❖ Led AML response to post Brexit regulatory changes, managing 30% increase in alert volumes
maintaining 100% SLA adherence with zero audit findings
❖ Transitioned TM from Actimize SAM to OFSAA UCM MANTAS; led UAT, scenario testing, and threshold
tuning—reduced false positives and false negatives; improved suspicious activity alert accuracy by 35%
❖ Hired, trained and coached 60 member team across sites to transition from legacy system to MANTAS ❖ Directed UAT for Quantexa TBML scenarios with a 6 member team; triaged issues, and supported
successful deployment of TBML detection capabilities
❖ Eliminated invalid RM escalations and duplicate steps for RFI process; completed “Project Filter,”
yielding capacity savings equivalent to 24 FTE while maintaining quality
ANZ Bank | Senior Analyst - Wealth Operations,Bangalore| June 2013 - May 2017
❖ Performed TM L1, L2 monitoring and SAR recommendations across AU/NZ jurisdictions, covering key
typologies such as Structuring, Mule accounts, Round Dollar wires, cash intensive activity etc
❖ Investigated complex financial crimes by evaluating suspicious activity flags like structuring,
round-dollar transactions, Fast-In-Fast-Out movements, dormant account anomalies, and high-risk geography exposure
❖ Applied a robust Risk-Based Approach (RBA) to prioritize and execute investigations, tailoring due
diligence and reporting based on the assessed threat level
❖ Acted as a SME for L2 Transaction Monitoring (Australia), enabling team capability uplift and advising
the MLRO on high-risk investigations,SAR/STR decisioning,regulatory reporting and audit/regulatory engagements
